new_today_news.headline: GFL Environmental Inc. Sets Date for Q2 2026 Earnings Release
new_today_news.summary: GFL Environmental announced it will release Q2 2026 financial results after market close on July 29, 2026, with an investor conference call on July 30, 2026.

new_today_news.headline: Agency Information Collection Activities; Proposed Information Collection Request; Comment Request; Renewable Fuel Standard (RFS) Program
new_today_news.summary: EPA issued a proposed information collection request for RFS Program compliance tracking, including recordkeeping requirements for waste feedstocks and biogas-derived renewable fuel. The notice opens a 60-day comment period through August 28, 2026.

recent_news.headline: GFL Environmental Added to Russell 1000 and Russell 3000 Indexes
recent_news.summary: GFL Environmental was added as a member of the U.S. large-cap Russell 1000 Index and broad-market Russell 3000 Index, effective at market opening.

recent_news.headline: 2026 Waste Hauling Business Valuation: CDL Class B Driver Shortage as Largest Cost Risk
recent_news.summary: Analysis identifies CDL Class B driver shortage as the single largest cost-side risk in waste hauling valuations. Wage inflation for refuse/recyclable material collectors hit 13.4% over two years (May 2022–May 2024), reaching $22.84/hour median, with top metros at $28–$35/hour. National multiples for waste hauling span 5x–13x EBITDA.
